key_insight: Reference-free PINNs resolve strong kinetic shocks with high accuracy, while higher-order moments reveal errors that density, velocity and temperature can miss.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a route to computing strongly nonequilibrium shock structure in high-speed rarefied-gas flows.
method: Correct an end-state Maxwellian mixture with an unbounded signed neural factor and exact inflow.
Train on kinetic residuals in three norms plus conservation terms, without reference data.
Use Adam, self-scaled quasi-Newton optimisation and Mach-number continuation.
evidence_signal: Across eight evaluated fields, the largest relative L2 difference from DSMC for hard-sphere Boltzmann shocks was 0.19% at Mach 8 and 0.34% at Mach 10.
watch_item: BGK fourth-order moments required greater loss weight on a passive reduced distribution and longer optimisation; errors still reached 7.1% at Mach 100.
paper_title: Physics-informed neural networks for strong normal shocks in kinetic relaxation models and the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
